text: They had lost the argument. So they turned to force.
"Burn him, and support your gods, if you are to act."
They said: build for him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire.
A young man, alone, falling into the flames.
And then Allah gave the fire a single command: "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim."

The fire that was made to burn... obeyed its Creator. And as they threw him, Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, had said: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ. Allah is enough for us, and He is the best Guardian.
"And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers."
But the fire was not his hardest test. That one would come years later... in a dream.
